name: People Cutout
description: Cuts people out from the background automatically, with no clicking — soft edges that keep hair looking natural.
details: Robust Video Matting, MobileNetV3 backbone, in ONNX. Recurrent human matting: no prompt, soft alpha rather than a hard mask, and a colour-decontaminated foreground that removes background spill from hair. Ships fp32 and fp16 weights; fp32 is used unless an execution provider is chosen by name. Package id: rvm.mobilenetv3.
author: CutWire
